parameters.description: Who needs to sign, as a list of objects. Each needs a name and an email_address, and may set a pin to require a code before signing. Each also needs a role naming the template role they fill. Dropbox Sign requires exactly one signer per role the template defines: List Dropbox Sign templates shows a template's roles in signer_roles, so a two-role template needs two entries here, one per role, or the request is rejected as having no recipients. If the same person fills more than one role, give each entry a distinct name; Dropbox Sign also rejects two signers that share both the same name and email address.
parameters.name: signers
